Name: Pate de Rolo companion (replaces parrot egg trinket)
Author: riabi
Description:
Replaces the Parrot Egg using  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], have your own impish taxidermy rat follow you around!

Pâté de Rolo is the familiar of Laudna, a character from the actual play show Critical Role, he is a dead rat with a raven skull swed on instead of a head.
